segments.sourceText: 自然博物馆快开新展览了。小穿山甲岩岩接到任务：让大家看懂，平时很稳的地面为什么有时会摇？
segments.spokenText: 自然博物馆快开新展览了。小穿山甲岩岩接到任务：让大家看懂，平时很稳的地面为什么有时会摇？

segments.sourceText: A new exhibition was opening at the natural history museum. Yan-Yan the little pangolin had a job: explain why the ground, usually so steady, sometimes shakes.
segments.spokenText: A new exhibition was opening at the natural history museum. Yan-Yan the little pangolin had a job: explain why the ground, usually so steady, sometimes shakes.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩把两块岩石模型摆好。它们纹丝不动。他问：
segments.spokenText: 岩岩把两块岩石模型摆好。它们纹丝不动。他问：

segments.sourceText: “大地也要有人推吗？”
segments.spokenText: “大地也要有人推吗？”

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan set two model rock blocks in place. They stayed still. He asked,
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan set two model rock blocks in place. They stayed still. He asked,

segments.sourceText: “Does someone have to push the Earth too?”
segments.spokenText: “Does someone have to push the Earth too?”

segments.sourceText: 讲解员带他看大地的地图。地球坚硬的外层分成许多板块，平时也在很慢地移动。它们的运动会让岩石受到挤压、拉伸或错开的作用。今天，岩岩先看向内挤压的一种情形。
segments.spokenText: 讲解员带他看大地的地图。地球坚硬的外层分成许多板块，平时也在很慢地移动。它们的运动会让岩石受到挤压、拉伸或错开的作用。今天，岩岩先看向内挤压的一种情形。

segments.sourceText: The guide showed him a map of Earth. Its hard outer shell is divided into plates that move very slowly, even on a quiet day. Their motion can squeeze, stretch, or shear rock. Today, Yan-Yan would watch one case of squeezing.
segments.spokenText: The guide showed him a map of Earth. Its hard outer shell is divided into plates that move very slowly, even on a quiet day. Their motion can squeeze, stretch, or shear rock. Today, Yan-Yan would watch one case of squeezing.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩轻轻推动模型。岩石里原有的接缝叫断层。两边被压在一起，摩擦阻住了滑动；外面的作用还在继续，周围岩石却已经发生了很小的弹性形变。放大看，原本直直的纹路弯了。
segments.spokenText: 岩岩轻轻推动模型。岩石里原有的接缝叫断层。两边被压在一起，摩擦阻住了滑动；外面的作用还在继续，周围岩石却已经发生了很小的弹性形变。放大看，原本直直的纹路弯了。

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan pushed gently. A fault is a break in rock along which its sides can slip. Here the sides were pressed together, and friction resisted sliding. The loading continued, so the surrounding rock deformed a little elastically. In the enlarged view, straight markings bent.
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan pushed gently. A fault is a break in rock along which its sides can slip. Here the sides were pressed together, and friction resisted sliding. The loading continued, so the surrounding rock deformed a little elastically. In the enlarged view, straight markings bent.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩盯着纹路：
segments.spokenText: 岩岩盯着纹路：

segments.sourceText: “接缝没滑，推过去的能量去哪了？”
segments.spokenText: “接缝没滑，推过去的能量去哪了？”

segments.sourceText: 一部分能量储存在变形的岩石里，就像弹簧被压缩后能弹回来。岩石不是软软的弹簧，但也能发生很小的弹性形变。
segments.spokenText: 一部分能量储存在变形的岩石里，就像弹簧被压缩后能弹回来。岩石不是软软的弹簧，但也能发生很小的弹性形变。

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan watched the markings.
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan watched the markings.

segments.sourceText: “If the fault has not slipped, where did the energy go?”
segments.spokenText: “If the fault has not slipped, where did the energy go?”

segments.sourceText: Some energy was stored in the deformed rock, just as a compressed spring stores energy. Rock is not a soft spring, but it can deform elastically by a small amount.
segments.spokenText: Some energy was stored in the deformed rock, just as a compressed spring stores energy. Rock is not a soft spring, but it can deform elastically by a small amount.

segments.sourceText: 继续加载，岩石沿断层滑动的趋势终于超过了这里的阻力，接缝突然滑了！周围岩石部分回弹，弯曲减小了。两边却已换了位置：纹路仍然错开，没有回到最初的样子。
segments.spokenText: 继续加载，岩石沿断层滑动的趋势终于超过了这里的阻力，接缝突然滑了！周围岩石部分回弹，弯曲减小了。两边却已换了位置：纹路仍然错开，没有回到最初的样子。

segments.sourceText: As loading continued, the tendency to slip overcame the resistance here. The fault slipped suddenly! The surrounding rock rebounded partly, and its bending decreased. But the sides were now in new positions. The markings stayed offset instead of returning to the beginning.
segments.spokenText: As loading continued, the tendency to slip overcame the resistance here. The fault slipped suddenly! The surrounding rock rebounded partly, and its bending decreased. But the sides were now in new positions. The markings stayed offset instead of returning to the beginning.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩问：
segments.spokenText: 岩岩问：

segments.sourceText: “那储存的能量呢？”
segments.spokenText: “那储存的能量呢？”

segments.sourceText: 一部分随着地震波向外传开，一部分变成了摩擦产生的热等。慢慢积累的能量，能在很短的时间里释放。
segments.spokenText: 一部分随着地震波向外传开，一部分变成了摩擦产生的热等。慢慢积累的能量，能在很短的时间里释放。

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan asked,
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan asked,

segments.sourceText: “What happened to the stored energy?”
segments.spokenText: “What happened to the stored energy?”

segments.sourceText: Some spread outward in seismic waves. Some became heat from friction and other changes. Energy that accumulated slowly could be released in a short time.
segments.spokenText: Some spread outward in seismic waves. Some became heat from friction and other changes. Energy that accumulated slowly could be released in a short time.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩在地下和地表各选了一个小标记，又留下近、远两面感应旗。他望着它们，等着看同一次振动怎样从地下传到地面。
segments.spokenText: 岩岩在地下和地表各选了一个小标记，又留下近、远两面感应旗。他望着它们，等着看同一次振动怎样从地下传到地面。

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan chose one marker underground and another at the surface, and left a near and a far signal flag. He watched them to see how one disturbance traveled from underground toward the surface.
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan chose one marker underground and another at the surface, and left a near and a far signal flag. He watched them to see how one disturbance traveled from underground toward the surface.

segments.sourceText: 波传过去时，地下的小标记在原位附近来回动。岩岩发现：
segments.spokenText: 波传过去时，地下的小标记在原位附近来回动。岩岩发现：

segments.sourceText: “它没有一路跑到地面！传开的是振动和能量。”
segments.spokenText: “它没有一路跑到地面！传开的是振动和能量。”

segments.sourceText: As the wave passed, the underground marker moved back and forth near its starting place. Yan-Yan noticed,
segments.spokenText: As the wave passed, the underground marker moved back and forth near its starting place. Yan-Yan noticed,

segments.sourceText: “It did not run all the way to the surface! The vibration and energy are spreading.”
segments.spokenText: “It did not run all the way to the surface! The vibration and energy are spreading.”

segments.sourceText: 振动到达地表，地表的小标记也在原位附近动起来。这就是波引起的地面振动。断层滑动留下的错位，与波经过时的来回振动，是两种不同的变化。
segments.spokenText: 振动到达地表，地表的小标记也在原位附近动起来。这就是波引起的地面振动。断层滑动留下的错位，与波经过时的来回振动，是两种不同的变化。

segments.sourceText: When the disturbance reached the surface, the surface marker also moved near its starting place. This was ground motion caused by the wave. The offset left by fault slip and the back-and-forth motion as a wave passes are two different changes.
segments.spokenText: When the disturbance reached the surface, the surface marker also moved near its starting place. This was ground motion caused by the wave. The offset left by fault slip and the back-and-forth motion as a wave passes are two different changes.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩把展览摆好了：持续作用让岩石变形并储能；断层突然滑动，周围岩石部分回弹；一部分能量随地震波传开，让经过的地方振动。每幅展图都连着一个“为什么”。
segments.spokenText: 岩岩把展览摆好了：持续作用让岩石变形并储能；断层突然滑动，周围岩石部分回弹；一部分能量随地震波传开，让经过的地方振动。每幅展图都连着一个“为什么”。

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan finished the display. Continued loading deformed rock and stored energy. Sudden fault slip allowed surrounding rock to rebound partly. Some energy spread in seismic waves, making the places they passed vibrate. Each exhibit answered a “why.”
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan finished the display. Continued loading deformed rock and stored energy. Sudden fault slip allowed surrounding rock to rebound partly. Some energy spread in seismic waves, making the places they passed vibrate. Each exhibit answered a “why.”

segments.sourceText: 小伙伴们来了。岩岩指着纹路、断层和两个小标记：
segments.spokenText: 小伙伴们来了。岩岩指着纹路、断层和两个小标记：

segments.sourceText: “先看慢慢积累，再看突然释放。地面摇，是振动传到了这里！”
segments.spokenText: “先看慢慢积累，再看突然释放。地面摇，是振动传到了这里！”

segments.sourceText: The visitors arrived. Yan-Yan pointed to the markings, the fault, and the two markers.
segments.spokenText: The visitors arrived. Yan-Yan pointed to the markings, the fault, and the two markers.

segments.sourceText: “First watch energy build slowly, then release suddenly. The ground shakes when the vibration reaches here!”
segments.spokenText: “First watch energy build slowly, then release suddenly. The ground shakes when the vibration reaches here!”

segments.sourceText: 板块不是等到地震才动。地球内部的热与重力等作用参与驱动板块缓慢运动。运动的板块可以把作用传到远处的岩石；一小段断层暂时锁住，并不意味着整个板块和周围岩石都停止变化。
segments.spokenText: 板块不是等到地震才动。地球内部的热与重力等作用参与驱动板块缓慢运动。运动的板块可以把作用传到远处的岩石；一小段断层暂时锁住，并不意味着整个板块和周围岩石都停止变化。

segments.sourceText: Plates do not wait for an earthquake to move. Processes involving Earth’s internal heat and gravity help drive their slow motion. Moving plates can load rock farther away. A locally locked part of a fault does not mean that a whole plate and all nearby rock have stopped changing.
segments.spokenText: Plates do not wait for an earthquake to move. Processes involving Earth’s internal heat and gravity help drive their slow motion. Moving plates can load rock farther away. A locally locked part of a fault does not mean that a whole plate and all nearby rock have stopped changing.

segments.sourceText: 断层两边的岩石相互接触。被压在一起的接触部位会抵抗滑动，这种阻力与摩擦有关。周围仍受作用时，岩石中的微小弹性形变可以储存能量。它并不需要先出现一条肉眼可见的大弯。
segments.spokenText: 断层两边的岩石相互接触。被压在一起的接触部位会抵抗滑动，这种阻力与摩擦有关。周围仍受作用时，岩石中的微小弹性形变可以储存能量。它并不需要先出现一条肉眼可见的大弯。

segments.sourceText: Rock on the two sides of a fault is in contact. Contact areas pressed together resist sliding through friction. While the surrounding rock remains loaded, tiny elastic deformation can store energy. No large, visible bend is needed.
segments.spokenText: Rock on the two sides of a fault is in contact. Contact areas pressed together resist sliding through friction. While the surrounding rock remains loaded, tiny elastic deformation can store energy. No large, visible bend is needed.

segments.sourceText: 在这种锁定后突然滑动的情形中，滑动开始后，阻力可能降低，使滑动很快发展。岩石的弹性形变减小，储存的部分能量释放；滑动停止后，两边仍可有永久错位，也可能仍有未释放的作用。另一些断层可以缓慢滑动，并不是每次板块移动都会发生地震。
segments.spokenText: 在这种锁定后突然滑动的情形中，滑动开始后，阻力可能降低，使滑动很快发展。岩石的弹性形变减小，储存的部分能量释放；滑动停止后，两边仍可有永久错位，也可能仍有未释放的作用。另一些断层可以缓慢滑动，并不是每次板块移动都会发生地震。

segments.sourceText: In this kind of sudden slip after locking, resistance can decrease once sliding starts, allowing slip to develop rapidly. Elastic deformation decreases and some stored energy is released. After motion stops, permanent offset and some remaining loading can persist. Other faults can creep slowly; not every movement of a plate produces an earthquake.
segments.spokenText: In this kind of sudden slip after locking, resistance can decrease once sliding starts, allowing slip to develop rapidly. Elastic deformation decreases and some stored energy is released. After motion stops, permanent offset and some remaining loading can persist. Other faults can creep slowly; not every movement of a plate produces an earthquake.

segments.sourceText: 波经过时，一处岩石的运动与变形影响相邻的岩石，变化接着传下去。单个小标记只在附近运动，能量却能传得更远。真实地震波有不同种类，地面可以向不同方向振动；图中选一个方向慢看，圆圈记录变化到达哪里，不是石头或能量的外壳。
segments.spokenText: 波经过时，一处岩石的运动与变形影响相邻的岩石，变化接着传下去。单个小标记只在附近运动，能量却能传得更远。真实地震波有不同种类，地面可以向不同方向振动；图中选一个方向慢看，圆圈记录变化到达哪里，不是石头或能量的外壳。

segments.sourceText: As a wave passes, motion and deformation at one place affect neighboring rock, carrying the disturbance onward. One marker moves locally, while energy can travel farther. Real seismic waves have different kinds of motion. This view slows one direction for observation; its circle marks where the disturbance has arrived, not a shell of rock or energy.

segments.spokenText: 接缝锁住，周围岩石形变并储能。灰色虚线留下了原来的纹路。

segments.sourceText: The fault is locked. Surrounding rock deforms and stores energy. Gray dashed lines show the original markings.
segments.spokenText: The fault is locked. Surrounding rock deforms and stores energy. Gray dashed lines show the original markings.

segments.sourceText: 阻力被克服，断层开始滑动，周围岩石部分回弹。
segments.spokenText: 阻力被克服，断层开始滑动，周围岩石部分回弹。

segments.sourceText: Resistance is overcome. The fault slips and surrounding rock rebounds partly.
segments.spokenText: Resistance is overcome. The fault slips and surrounding rock rebounds partly.

segments.sourceText: 变形减小了，纹路却仍错开：回弹与永久错位可以同时留下。
segments.spokenText: 变形减小了，纹路却仍错开：回弹与永久错位可以同时留下。

segments.sourceText: Deformation decreased, but the markings remain offset: rebound can leave permanent fault offset.
segments.spokenText: Deformation decreased, but the markings remain offset: rebound can leave permanent fault offset.

segments.sourceText: 看振动传开，也看小标记留在哪里。
segments.spokenText: 看振动传开，也看小标记留在哪里。

segments.sourceText: Watch the disturbance spread, and see where each marker stays.
segments.spokenText: Watch the disturbance spread, and see where each marker stays.

segments.sourceText: 地下与地表标记都在原位；同一次振动将依次到达。
segments.spokenText: 地下与地表标记都在原位；同一次振动将依次到达。

segments.sourceText: Both markers are at their starting places. One disturbance will reach them in turn.
segments.spokenText: Both markers are at their starting places. One disturbance will reach them in turn.

segments.sourceText: 振动经过地下标记：标记在附近来回动，变化继续传向地表。
segments.spokenText: 振动经过地下标记：标记在附近来回动，变化继续传向地表。

segments.sourceText: The disturbance passes the underground marker. It moves locally as the disturbance continues toward the surface.
segments.spokenText: The disturbance passes the underground marker. It moves locally as the disturbance continues toward the surface.

segments.sourceText: 振动到达地表，地表标记也来回动起来；地下标记没有跑上来。
segments.spokenText: 振动到达地表，地表标记也来回动起来；地下标记没有跑上来。

segments.sourceText: The disturbance reaches the surface marker and it moves locally too. The underground marker did not travel up here.
segments.spokenText: The disturbance reaches the surface marker and it moves locally too. The underground marker did not travel up here.

segments.sourceText: 脉冲已经过这两个标记，它们回到原位附近；到达记录留下了传播的先后。
segments.spokenText: 脉冲已经过这两个标记，它们回到原位附近；到达记录留下了传播的先后。

segments.sourceText: The pulse has passed both markers. They are near their starting places; arrival records show the sequence of propagation.
segments.spokenText: The pulse has passed both markers. They are near their starting places; arrival records show the sequence of propagation.

segments.sourceText: 灰色圈是原位，彩色点是现在：放大看往返，不随波跑走。
segments.spokenText: 灰色圈是原位，彩色点是现在：放大看往返，不随波跑走。

segments.sourceText: The gray ring is the starting place; the colored point is its current position. Enlarge the back-and-forth motion without following the wave.
segments.spokenText: The gray ring is the starting place; the colored point is its current position. Enlarge the back-and-forth motion without following the wave.

segments.sourceText: 远处怎样受力，两侧就怎样相对滑动？
segments.spokenText: 远处怎样受力，两侧就怎样相对滑动？

segments.sourceText: How does loading relate to the relative slip direction?
segments.spokenText: How does loading relate to the relative slip direction?

segments.sourceText: 换一个地下起点，正上方会怎样改变？
segments.spokenText: 换一个地下起点，正上方会怎样改变？

segments.sourceText: If the underground start changes, what happens directly above it?
segments.spokenText: If the underground start changes, what happens directly above it?

segments.sourceText: 能量传到地表，岩石会被一路带走吗？
segments.spokenText: 能量传到地表，岩石会被一路带走吗？

segments.sourceText: Does travelling energy carry the rock all the way to the surface?
segments.spokenText: Does travelling energy carry the rock all the way to the surface?

segments.sourceText: 先找棕色标记线和远端受力箭头；接缝还没有滑动。
segments.spokenText: 先找棕色标记线和远端受力箭头；接缝还没有滑动。

segments.sourceText: Find the brown marker and loading arrows. The fault has not slipped.
segments.spokenText: Find the brown marker and loading arrows. The fault has not slipped.

segments.sourceText: 接缝被摩擦锁住。远处仍受力，标记线弯了，岩石储存弹性能。
segments.spokenText: 接缝被摩擦锁住。远处仍受力，标记线弯了，岩石储存弹性能。

segments.sourceText: Friction locks the fault. Loading continues farther away; the marker bends as rock stores elastic energy.
segments.spokenText: Friction locks the fault. Loading continues farther away; the marker bends as rock stores elastic energy.

segments.sourceText: 突然滑动后，弯曲减少、储能下降，但标记线留下错位。
segments.spokenText: 突然滑动后，弯曲减少、储能下降，但标记线留下错位。

segments.sourceText: After sudden slip, bending and stored energy decrease, but the marker stays offset.
segments.spokenText: After sudden slip, bending and stored energy decrease, but the marker stays offset.

segments.sourceText: 振动可以停下，错位却不会自动复原；回弹不等于两侧退回原位。
segments.spokenText: 振动可以停下，错位却不会自动复原；回弹不等于两侧退回原位。

segments.sourceText: Shaking can stop while the offset remains. Rebound does not undo the slip.
segments.spokenText: Shaking can stop while the offset remains. Rebound does not undo the slip.

segments.sourceText: 看远端受力箭头，再比同一层岩石的相对错位；类型不是强弱排名。
segments.spokenText: 看远端受力箭头，再比同一层岩石的相对错位；类型不是强弱排名。

segments.sourceText: Compare the loading arrows with the offset of the same rock layer. Fault types do not rank earthquake strength.
segments.spokenText: Compare the loading arrows with the offset of the same rock layer. Fault types do not rank earthquake strength.

segments.sourceText: 红点是破裂开始的位置。显示竖直投影，再换一个起点比较。
segments.spokenText: 红点是破裂开始的位置。显示竖直投影，再换一个起点比较。

segments.sourceText: The red point marks where rupture starts. Show its vertical projection, then compare another start.
segments.spokenText: The red point marks where rupture starts. Show its vertical projection, then compare another start.

segments.sourceText: 红点是震源；沿竖线到地表的圈是震中，不一定是摇得最强的地方。
segments.spokenText: 红点是震源；沿竖线到地表的圈是震中，不一定是摇得最强的地方。

segments.sourceText: The red point is the focus. The surface ring directly above is the epicenter, not necessarily the strongest shaking.
segments.spokenText: The red point is the focus. The surface ring directly above is the epicenter, not necessarily the strongest shaking.

segments.sourceText: 波前传递能量，地下和地表黄点只在各自原位附近往复。
segments.spokenText: 波前传递能量，地下和地表黄点只在各自原位附近往复。

segments.sourceText: The front carries energy; underground and surface yellow points move around their own places.
segments.spokenText: The front carries energy; underground and surface yellow points move around their own places.

segments.sourceText: 同一观测点先收到 P、再收到 S；局部振动结束后，黄点回到原处。
segments.spokenText: 同一观测点先收到 P、再收到 S；局部振动结束后，黄点回到原处。

segments.sourceText: At one observation point P arrives before S. After each pulse the yellow point returns to its place.
segments.spokenText: At one observation point P arrives before S. After each pulse the yellow point returns to its place.

segments.sourceText: 断层是岩石中可发生相对滑移的面，不是空隙。
segments.spokenText: 断层是岩石中可发生相对滑移的面，不是空隙。

segments.sourceText: A fault is a surface where rock can slip relatively, not an empty gap.
segments.spokenText: A fault is a surface where rock can slip relatively, not an empty gap.

segments.sourceText: 标记线记录岩石先形变、后留下永久错位。
segments.spokenText: 标记线记录岩石先形变、后留下永久错位。

segments.sourceText: The marker records deformation followed by a lasting offset.
segments.spokenText: The marker records deformation followed by a lasting offset.

segments.sourceText: 震源：地下起裂点
segments.spokenText: 震源：地下起裂点

segments.sourceText: Focus: underground rupture start
segments.spokenText: Focus: underground rupture start

segments.sourceText: 震中：震源正上方的地表点
segments.spokenText: 震中：震源正上方的地表点

segments.sourceText: Epicenter: the surface point above the focus
segments.spokenText: Epicenter: the surface point above the focus

segments.sourceText: 向外传播的波前
segments.spokenText: 向外传播的波前

segments.sourceText: Outward travelling wavefront
segments.spokenText: Outward travelling wavefront

segments.sourceText: 黄点代表一小块岩石，不是随波奔跑的球。
segments.spokenText: 黄点代表一小块岩石，不是随波奔跑的球。

segments.sourceText: A yellow point stands for a small piece of rock, not a ball travelling with the wave.
segments.spokenText: A yellow point stands for a small piece of rock, not a ball travelling with the wave.

segments.sourceText: 地球坚硬的外层由缓慢运动的板块组成，并不是松散漂浮的碎石。持续构造作用让岩石受力。接下来只观察其中一小段断层，不是把整块板块用手推动。
segments.spokenText: 地球坚硬的外层由缓慢运动的板块组成，并不是松散漂浮的碎石。持续构造作用让岩石受力。接下来只观察其中一小段断层，不是把整块板块用手推动。

segments.sourceText: Earth’s rigid outer layer forms slowly moving plates, not loose floating stones. Tectonic loading stresses rock. Here we inspect a small fault segment, not push an entire plate by hand.
segments.spokenText: Earth’s rigid outer layer forms slowly moving plates, not loose floating stones. Tectonic loading stresses rock. Here we inspect a small fault segment, not push an entire plate by hand.

segments.sourceText: 断层两侧接触面的摩擦能让局部暂时卡住，远处却仍在受力。坚硬岩石也能产生很小的弹性形变，把能量储存在形变中。标记线和能量条把这件事放大给你看；真实积累可能很慢，不能据此倒数地震。
segments.spokenText: 断层两侧接触面的摩擦能让局部暂时卡住，远处却仍在受力。坚硬岩石也能产生很小的弹性形变，把能量储存在形变中。标记线和能量条把这件事放大给你看；真实积累可能很慢，不能据此倒数地震。

segments.sourceText: Friction can lock a local fault patch while loading continues farther away. Even hard rock deforms slightly and stores elastic energy. The marker and energy bar exaggerate this evidence; real loading can be slow and cannot provide an earthquake countdown.
segments.spokenText: Friction can lock a local fault patch while loading continues farther away. Even hard rock deforms slightly and stores elastic energy. The marker and energy bar exaggerate this evidence; real loading can be slow and cannot provide an earthquake countdown.

segments.sourceText: 本模型的驱动力越过静摩擦门槛后，断层开始滑移。附近岩石部分回弹，弹性储能减少，一部分能量以地震波传播。两块岩石已有相对错位，所以回弹不是把断层两侧退回最初位置。
segments.spokenText: 本模型的驱动力越过静摩擦门槛后，断层开始滑移。附近岩石部分回弹，弹性储能减少，一部分能量以地震波传播。两块岩石已有相对错位，所以回弹不是把断层两侧退回最初位置。

segments.sourceText: When this model crosses its static-friction threshold, the fault slips. Nearby rock partly rebounds, reducing stored elastic energy; some energy travels as seismic waves. The blocks remain offset, so rebound does not restore their original positions.
segments.spokenText: When this model crosses its static-friction threshold, the fault slips. Nearby rock partly rebounds, reducing stored elastic energy; some energy travels as seismic waves. The blocks remain offset, so rebound does not restore their original positions.

segments.sourceText: “没有继续摇”与“没有发生过滑动”不同。对比最初和现在的标记线：弯曲减小了，跨断层的错位仍在。真实地震还可能有余震；这个单次事件模型不计算它们。
segments.spokenText: “没有继续摇”与“没有发生过滑动”不同。对比最初和现在的标记线：弯曲减小了，跨断层的错位仍在。真实地震还可能有余震；这个单次事件模型不计算它们。

segments.sourceText: No more shaking does not mean no slip occurred. Compare the marker before and after: bending decreases but offset remains. Real earthquakes may have aftershocks; this single-event model does not calculate them.
segments.spokenText: No more shaking does not mean no slip occurred. Compare the marker before and after: bending decreases but offset remains. Real earthquakes may have aftershocks; this single-event model does not calculate them.

segments.sourceText: 远端向外拉伸时，上盘相对下盘沿倾斜断层向下滑。青箭头是远端受力方向，橙箭头是相对滑动；它们不是同一件事。这里固定几何与错位大小，只比较方向。
segments.spokenText: 远端向外拉伸时，上盘相对下盘沿倾斜断层向下滑。青箭头是远端受力方向，橙箭头是相对滑动；它们不是同一件事。这里固定几何与错位大小，只比较方向。

segments.sourceText: Under extension, the hanging wall slips down relative to the footwall along the dipping fault. Cyan arrows show remote loading; orange arrows show relative slip. With geometry and offset fixed here, compare directions only.
segments.spokenText: Under extension, the hanging wall slips down relative to the footwall along the dipping fault. Cyan arrows show remote loading; orange arrows show relative slip. With geometry and offset fixed here, compare directions only.

segments.sourceText: 远端挤压时，上盘相对下盘沿倾斜断层向上滑。上盘指断层面上方的岩体，并不保证它始终比另一侧高。颜色相同的岩层帮助你确认相对错位。
segments.spokenText: 远端挤压时，上盘相对下盘沿倾斜断层向上滑。上盘指断层面上方的岩体，并不保证它始终比另一侧高。颜色相同的岩层帮助你确认相对错位。

segments.sourceText: Under compression, the hanging wall slips up relative to the footwall along the dipping fault. Hanging wall means the block above the fault plane, not always the higher block. Matching rock layers reveal the relative offset.
segments.spokenText: Under compression, the hanging wall slips up relative to the footwall along the dipping fault. Hanging wall means the block above the fault plane, not always the higher block. Matching rock layers reveal the relative offset.

segments.sourceText: 两侧沿断层走向水平错开。用俯视看前后相反方向的箭头，再用同一条标记确认错位。真实断层可以混合水平与上下运动，这里分开展示三种理想方向。
segments.spokenText: 两侧沿断层走向水平错开。用俯视看前后相反方向的箭头，再用同一条标记确认错位。真实断层可以混合水平与上下运动，这里分开展示三种理想方向。

segments.sourceText: The sides slip horizontally along the fault’s strike. Use the top view to compare opposite arrows and the same marker. Real faults can combine horizontal and vertical motion; these are separate idealized directions.
segments.spokenText: The sides slip horizontally along the fault’s strike. Use the top view to compare opposite arrows and the same marker. Real faults can combine horizontal and vertical motion; these are separate idealized directions.

segments.sourceText: 震源是破裂最先开始的位置，震中是它的竖直地表投影。换起点会改变投影以及到各观测点的路程。破裂之后可以沿断层扩展，不是只有一个点在活动；这里没有求解有限破裂过程。
segments.spokenText: 震源是破裂最先开始的位置，震中是它的竖直地表投影。换起点会改变投影以及到各观测点的路程。破裂之后可以沿断层扩展，不是只有一个点在活动；这里没有求解有限破裂过程。

segments.sourceText: The focus is where rupture starts; the epicenter is its vertical surface projection. Changing the start changes the projection and paths to observation points. Rupture can spread along a fault, but this model does not solve finite rupture propagation.
segments.spokenText: The focus is where rupture starts; the epicenter is its vertical surface projection. Changing the start changes the projection and paths to observation points. Rupture can spread along a fault, but this model does not solve finite rupture propagation.

segments.sourceText: P 波传来时，邻近岩石沿传播方向交替压缩、伸展，恢复力把扰动继续传给下一处。跟着黄点看：它先向一边、再向另一边，最后回到原位；波前仍在向外走。
segments.spokenText: P 波传来时，邻近岩石沿传播方向交替压缩、伸展，恢复力把扰动继续传给下一处。跟着黄点看：它先向一边、再向另一边，最后回到原位；波前仍在向外走。

segments.sourceText: In a P wave, nearby rock alternately compresses and stretches along the propagation direction. Restoring forces pass the disturbance onward. The yellow point moves one way, then back, returning to its origin while the front travels outward.
segments.spokenText: In a P wave, nearby rock alternately compresses and stretches along the propagation direction. Restoring forces pass the disturbance onward. The yellow point moves one way, then back, returning to its origin while the front travels outward.

segments.sourceText: S 波让邻近岩石沿垂直于传播方向的方向往复剪切。它传播较慢，但不是因为要等 P 波结束才出发。对照同一个观测点的到时：路程相同，速度不同，所以先后到达。
segments.spokenText: S 波让邻近岩石沿垂直于传播方向的方向往复剪切。它传播较慢，但不是因为要等 P 波结束才出发。对照同一个观测点的到时：路程相同，速度不同，所以先后到达。

segments.sourceText: An S wave produces back-and-forth shear perpendicular to its propagation direction. It is slower, not waiting for P to finish before starting. At the same observation point, equal path lengths and different speeds give different arrival times.
segments.spokenText: An S wave produces back-and-forth shear perpendicular to its propagation direction. It is slower, not waiting for P to finish before starting. At the same observation point, equal path lengths and different speeds give different arrival times.

segments.sourceText: 颜色表示两种波前；地下黄点和地表黄点表示岩石的局部运动，不是移动的能量球。先单看 P 或 S 的运动方向，再一起看它们的到时差。只有波经过的地方才在这次脉冲中振动。
segments.spokenText: 颜色表示两种波前；地下黄点和地表黄点表示岩石的局部运动，不是移动的能量球。先单看 P 或 S 的运动方向，再一起看它们的到时差。只有波经过的地方才在这次脉冲中振动。

segments.sourceText: Colors show two wavefronts. Underground and surface yellow points represent local rock motion, not travelling energy balls. Inspect P or S motion first, then compare arrival times. A point moves during this pulse only as a wave passes it.
segments.spokenText: Colors show two wavefronts. Underground and surface yellow points represent local rock motion, not travelling energy balls. Inspect P or S motion first, then compare arrival times. A point moves during this pulse only as a wave passes it.
